challenges.claim: SB-B-02 / highestValueExperiment: compare two peeks with one
challenges.response: Accept a comparison, but first establish what the existing second peek does. Closing at 2190ms and reopening at 2520ms could mean renewed conspiratorial checking, not surplus activity. A knowing hold changes that intention as well as rhythm. Specify both candidate readings before comparison; a sleepy-looking 1550ms still cannot adjudicate a temporal joke.
